title: Board-Approved Payment Plan for Pre-K Tuition Balances
content:
## Terms

A family may settle the open balance of a Pre-K tuition account under the board-approved payment plan, whose first installment the parent or guardian pays personally in the district's online payment portal (district staff never take card or bank details); the later installments fall due on the first day of each following month. Pre-K tuition accounts here are those of Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions.

Tuition is paid by the methods the type accepts and is applied to the enrollment's oldest open charge first, and a payment never moves to a sibling's enrollment; an advance payment under the advance-payment schedule is made only in the district's online payment portal, which takes online card and ACH bank draft payments, a first installment under the payment-plan schedule is likewise made only in that portal, and every other tuition payment may still be made by personal check or money order at the campus cashier.

The first installment of a payment plan is not fixed until the eligibility-transition waiver owed on the late fee of the enrollment's most recent billing month has been worked out and posted.

## Paying the first installment: `pay_prek_plan_installment_1e1e8562`

**Capability.** The portal takes the first installment and books one tuition payment entry on the enrollment, dated today. The installment lowers the amount the household owes, and the rest of the balance stays open for the later installments. The parent receives a payment confirmation number.

**How it is invoked.** This is the customer's own tool. The support agent unlocks `pay_prek_plan_installment_1e1e8562` and hands it over; the parent or guardian, the customer themselves, runs it and enters the payment details in the portal.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | What it is | Format and values |
|---|---|---|
| `enrollment_id` | the reference number of the student's Pre-K enrollment record for the school year, as given by the support agent from the enrollment lookup | text id |
| `amount` | the first installment quoted by the support agent | US dollars, a positive number with 2 decimal places; the portal rounds half up to the cent |
| `payment_method` | how the parent pays | exactly one of: `online_card` (a debit or credit card entered in the portal); `ach_bank_draft` (a checking or savings account by bank draft entered in the portal); `personal_check` (a paper check, taken only at the campus cashier, so the portal refuses it); `money_order` (taken only at the campus cashier, so the portal refuses it); `not_applicable` (no payment method, which the portal refuses) |

**Return.** On success, a one-line receipt beginning "Plan installment received:" gives the payment confirmation number (eight digits), the new ledger entry reference, the enrollment reference, the amount paid (USD, two decimals), the payment method and the posting date (YYYY-MM-DD). A receipt beginning "Error:" means no payment was taken because an argument did not meet its format: a payment method other than `online_card` or `ach_bank_draft`, or an amount that is not positive.
